0022600110.text: The Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West, 5th in the Northwest and 1.5 games back) host the Pelicans (0-2, 10th in the West, 4th in the Southwest and 2 games back) in Denver's second game of the season. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
